_meta.notes: European Portuguese (Portugal). Auto-translated draft. Native-speaker review welcome via PR. Distinct from pt-BR (Brasil): differs in lexicon (utilizador / você), conjugation, and some terms. TUI symbols (↑/↓, ⚠) and key names (Enter, Esc, Tab, Space, n, Ctrl+G, Ctrl+U) are universal CLI conventions and stay untranslated.
